name: Asha Wren
title: Glacier Vow
description: A composed ice duelist. She waits, then ends rounds with frozen counter-fire.
source_description: Female fighter, compact, ivory hair, teal robes, patient personality, ice-based powers.
special_desc: A mid-range ice pillar that freezes hitstun longer.
ultimate_desc: Seals the opponent in a collapsing prism.
